summary: Phase 1 implementation of the frontend redirecting loop. Key features include dual-entry Home UI (Plan Start & Focus Now), refactored 3-step Chronos flow (Setup -> Timer -> Reflection), and session state key minimization. Rerun churn was reduced by introducing st.form for reflections.

outputs.description: Updated Stream mode and Chronos mode implementation.

evidence.name: Home UI Dual CTA Check
evidence.note: Verified prominent Plan Start and Focus Now buttons in the empty state.

evidence.name: Chronos 3-Step Flow Sync
evidence.note: Verified Setup, Timer, and Reflection stage logic.

evidence.name: State Minimization Check
evidence.note: Verified session_id, flow_stage, entry_mode, and reflection_draft initialization.

risks.description: Streamlit's JavaScript-based countdown timer might lose sync on heavy background processing.
risks.mitigation: Introduced server-side check (st.session_state['chronos_end_time']) for final verdict.

next_actions: Wait for Phase 1 PASS gate verdict.
Begin Phase 2: Reflection evidence curation (1-2 images/skip).
